## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any relevant limitations. For visual changes, include screenshots using synthetic data.

## Review

- [ ] Changes are focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Appropriate checks pass, or failures are explained above.
- [ ] No personal notes, credentials, tokens, or local runtime files are included.
- [ ] Dependency changes include lockfiles and regenerated notices where applicable.
